> I read this as test authoring (TDD/RED verification) - inspect SplitEdgeDropZone, TerminalSplitView, BrowserPane, browserTauri, and DnD runtime contracts, then write targeted Vitest suites without touching production code.

### Test Implementation Summary

1. **`ui/src/components/tab-dnd/SplitEdgeDropZone.test.tsx`**
   - Added parameterized tests (`it.each`) for all 4 split edges (`left`, `right`, `top`, `bottom`) verifying:
     - The droppable hit strip retains its 20% margin geometry (`inset-y-0 left-0 w-[20%]`, `inset-y-0 right-0 w-[20%]`, `left-[20%] right-[20%] top-0 h-[20%]`, `bottom-0 left-[20%] right-[20%] h-[20%]`).
     - When `isOver` is active, a distinct visual preview element (`[data-testid="split-edge-preview"]`, `data-split-edge-preview="true"`, `data-preview-edge`) is rendered and covers exactly half (50%) of the parent container (`w-1/2` / `h-1/2`).
     - When `isOver` is false, no preview element is rendered.
   - Maintained all existing feedback tests without weakening.

2. **`ui/src/components/TerminalSplitView.browserDragVisibility.runtime.test.tsx`**
   - Added integration runtime tests for `TerminalSplitView` and `BrowserPane`:
     - Proves active native browser webviews are hidden via `setBrowserVisible(browserId, false)` on workspace drag start.
     - Proves active native browser webviews are restored via `setBrowserVisible(browserId, true)` on `onDragEnd`.
     - Proves active native browser webviews are restored via `setBrowserVisible(browserId, true)` on `onDragCancel`.
     - Mocked `browserTauri` narrowly (`setBrowserVisible`, `setBrowserBounds`) and awaited effects deterministically via `waitFor` with zero sleeps.

3. **`ui/src/components/TerminalSplitView.paneDrop.runtime.test.tsx`**
   - Added runtime test capturing registered pane-edge droppable data directly from `useDroppable` (`pane-edge:tab-target:leaf-right:left`).
   - Feeds the registered droppable data through `DndContext` `onDragStart` and `onDragEnd`.
   - Asserts the production payload: `onMoveTabToSplit("tab-source", "group-default", "horizontal", "first", { tabId: "tab-target", leafId: "leaf-right" })`.

---

### Test Execution Results

Command executed:
```bash
cd ui && bunx vitest run src/components/tab-dnd/SplitEdgeDropZone.test.tsx src/components/TerminalSplitView.browserDragVisibility.runtime.test.tsx src/components/TerminalSplitView.paneDrop.runtime.test.tsx
```

#### Test Suite Summary
```
 Test Files  2 failed | 1 passed (3)
      Tests  6 failed | 5 passed (11)
   Duration  3.62s
```

#### 1. PASSING PATH (Payload Execution)
- **`src/components/TerminalSplitView.paneDrop.runtime.test.tsx`** (3/3 passed)
  - `registers four edge drop zones inside every rendered terminal pane instead of only around the group/window` (PASS)
  - `always resolves the hovered pane edge ahead of the overlapping group edge, including the active tab top edge` (PASS)
  - `obtains registered pane-edge droppable data from useDroppable and executes production onMoveTabToSplit payload on drop` (PASS - confirms existing pane-edge payload resolution functions correctly)

#### 2. RED FAILURES (Intended Missing Behaviors)

##### A. Visual Preview Coverage (Missing 50% split preview element)
- **`src/components/tab-dnd/SplitEdgeDropZone.test.tsx`** (4 failed | 2 passed)
  - **Failure Reason**: `SplitEdgeDropZone` currently applies border/background classes directly onto the 20% hit zone and does not render a distinct 50% parent visual preview element (`[data-testid="split-edge-preview"]`).
  - **Exact Failure Output**:
    ```
    FAIL src/components/tab-dnd/SplitEdgeDropZone.test.tsx > SplitEdgeDropZone > retains 20% droppable hit strip but renders distinct 50% half-parent visual preview for 'left' edge
    TestingLibraryElementError: Unable to find an element by: [data-testid="split-edge-preview"]

    FAIL src/components/tab-dnd/SplitEdgeDropZone.test.tsx > SplitEdgeDropZone > retains 20% droppable hit strip but renders distinct 50% half-parent visual preview for 'right' edge
    TestingLibraryElementError: Unable to find an element by: [data-testid="split-edge-preview"]

    FAIL src/components/tab-dnd/SplitEdgeDropZone.test.tsx > SplitEdgeDropZone > retains 20% droppable hit strip but renders distinct 50% half-parent visual preview for 'top' edge
    TestingLibraryElementError: Unable to find an element by: [data-testid="split-edge-preview"]

    FAIL src/components/tab-dnd/SplitEdgeDropZone.test.tsx > SplitEdgeDropZone > retains 20% droppable hit strip but renders distinct 50% half-parent visual preview for 'bottom' edge
    TestingLibraryElementError: Unable to find an element by: [data-testid="split-edge-preview"]
    ```

##### B. Browser Webview Visibility during Drag (Missing hide on dragStart / restore on dragEnd/cancel)
- **`src/components/TerminalSplitView.browserDragVisibility.runtime.test.tsx`** (2 failed)
  - **Failure Reason**: `TerminalSplitView` does not track drag state to pass `visible={false}` or call `setBrowserVisible(browserId, false)` on drag start.
  - **Exact Failure Output**:
    ```
    FAIL src/components/TerminalSplitView.browserDragVisibility.runtime.test.tsx > TerminalSplitView native browser webview drag visibility > hides active native browser webview on workspace drag start and restores visibility on drag end
    AssertionError: expected "spy" to be called with arguments: [ 'browser-instance-1', false ]
    Number of calls: 0

    FAIL src/components/TerminalSplitView.browserDragVisibility.runtime.test.tsx > TerminalSplitView native browser webview drag visibility > hides active native browser webview on workspace drag start and restores visibility on drag cancel
    AssertionError: expected "spy" to be called with arguments: [ 'browser-instance-2', false ]
    Number of calls: 0
    ```
